localCutout.method: deterministic green-dominance alpha matte with partial-edge despill
localCutout.backgroundRule: G >= 200 and G - max(R,B) >= 160 yields alpha 0
localCutout.opaqueRule: G - max(R,B) <= 0 yields alpha 255 with unchanged RGB
localCutout.matteRule: otherwise alpha = round(255 * (1 - min(1, (G - max(R,B)) / max(1, 249 - max(R,B)))))
localCutout.despillRule: only for 0 < alpha < 255, clamp G to max(R,B)
